description: Search UFCalendar's own editorial archive — previews, recaps, investigations, fighter-pay and technique pieces — by keyword or tag, newest first, in any of the 13 site languages. Returns title, summary, tags, date and the canonical URL; pass the slug to get_article for the body. Betting editorial is not served.

locale.description: Site language to serve (default en); English when no translation exists.

q.description: Keyword, at least 2 characters: matches the title, summary or a tag.

name: search_articles
title: Search UFCalendar articles
